extracted.intended_audience: faculty and researchers preparing NIH grant proposals (R01/R21) at Marquette University
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and resources for faculty/researchers preparing NIH grant applications (particularly R01 and R21). Lists materials to learn how reviewers evaluate applications and templates/boilerplate to use in preparing submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: NIH peer review process — understand how reviewers assess scientific merit
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH Peer Review Revealed: This video provides a front-row seat to an NIH peer review meeting. Real scientists from the scientific community review fictional but realistic grant applications for scientific merit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Watch the video to observe how reviewers discuss strengths and weaknesses and to internalize the criteria and interpersonal dynamics used when assessing scientific merit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow reviewer guidelines and use reviewer templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Reviewer Guidelines and Templates: Review the general guidelines for study section reviewers and chairs as well as fillable reviewer templates for all current applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Study the official reviewer guidelines and use or consult the fillable reviewer templates to understand what reviewers are asked to evaluate and to structure applications to align with review expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study annotated successful NIH R01 and R21 applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Annotated Successful NIH R01 and R21 Applications: NIAID provides samples and examples that are part of the grant application from NIH.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examine full annotated R01 and R21 applications and sample attachments (Data Management Plan information, Model Organism Sharing Plans, Project Leadership Plans for Multi-PI proposals, etc.) to see concrete examples of successful content, formatting, and required documents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review abstracts of prior awards in your program of interest (use RePORTER)
rubrics_metrics.description: Review Abstracts of Prior Awards for your Program of Interest: Search the NIH award abstract database (RePORTER) by funding mechanism, keyword, and institute.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use RePORTER to identify previously funded projects similar to your proposal’s scope and aims; analyze their abstracts to understand priorities, language, and fundable approaches. Contact the listed campus assistance (Karen Jamiola) if help is needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use institutional boilerplate and standard resource pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutional Boilerplate for NIH Applications: ORSP provides sample Resource pages, AREA (R15) boilerplate, and standard descriptions of Marquette University.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate approved institutional language and resource descriptions (boilerplate) provided by ORSP to ensure consistency and completeness of institutional sections and to avoid having reviewers question institutional support or resource availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use The Grant Application Writer's Workbook (NIH version) as a step-by-step guide
rubrics_metrics.description: The Grant Application Writer's Workbook: Contact Karen Jamiola to check out The Grant Application Writer's Workbook: National Institutes of Health Version by Stephen W. Russell and David C. Morrison.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the workbook as a practical guide to drafting and organizing NIH applications; consult the Grant Development Office staff to access this resource.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult local Grant Development Office contacts for proposal support
rubrics_metrics.description: CONTACT: Dr. Brian Schmit (Associate Dean for Research) and Karen Jamiola (Engineering Grant Development Manager) are listed as contacts for the Grant Development Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reach out to listed contacts for assistance with resource access, reviewing institutional boilerplate, navigating RePORTER searches, or other proposal-development support offered by the college.
